description: Potentiel éolien en région PACA is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by crige-paca.org. These data correspond to the outcome of the project "Realisation of a wind deposit atlas on the Provence-Alpes-Côte d'Azur region" carried out within the framework of the State-Region project contract 2007-2013, and piloted by ADEME PACA. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Wind potential in the PACA region" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 2008-07-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
